_schema: Motion guard baseline (spec V1 acceptance row A5, Delight Task 3 Phase 3). Per migrated file: `count` is the number of raw `transition={{ ... }}` opener literals ALLOWED in that file (the ratchet floor), and `authority` says why. New motion consumes src/theme/motion.js; a raw transition literal added to a guarded file trips the guard. The guarded-file list EXPANDS as surfaces migrate (adoption is per-surface and D3-gated). Regen after a deliberate change: GENERATE_MOTION_GUARD_BASELINE=1 npx vitest run src/theme/motion.guard.test.js, then commit this file in the same commit.
